structure: Part 13 mined 16 Playwright trace zips (all passed) from five animals E2E specs in trade-imports-ins-tests: hub-groups-and-cya-rows.spec.ts (2), change-from-cya.spec.ts (1), task-page-exits.spec.ts (1), reference-strip.spec.ts (1) and pages/notification-view-states.spec.ts (11: DRAFT x5, DRAFT ready to submit x2, SUBMITTED x4). All five specs were read in full. The tim-wrapped `playwright trace open` refused every zip (TraceVersionError: trace written by a newer Playwright than tim installs), so each zip's extracted contents (already unzipped into this part's work folder, verified against `unzip -l` sizes) were read directly with jq: every action (`before` events) of each trace's 1-trace.trace, every page snapshot rendered from frame-snapshot events, and every browser and API-context network log (1/2/3-trace.network). Refs below name the trace by its zip folder slug prefix and hash plus a Playwright callId. Pages, in journey order: dashboard (/live-animals, only to show no strip and to start a notification) -> origin entry page (/notifications/<ref>/origin, carries the strip from the first request) -> hub 'Overview' (/notifications/<ref>; six numbered task-list groups, commodity totals, Review and submit / Return to dashboard) -> task pages (origin, commodities, additional-details in change context; each with Save and continue / Save and return to overview / Cancel and return to overview) -> 'Review your notification' (/notifications/<ref>/notification-view) in three states: DRAFT unfinished (error summary listing what is left, error-styled cards with Missing rows, Change links, Continue POST returns 400 and stays), DRAFT ready to submit (all rows answered, Change and Edit details links, Continue -> /declaration), SUBMITTED (green Submitted strip, Copy as new and Delete at the top, read-only cards) -> Declaration (reached only, heading and form recorded) -> copy lands on a new draft's hub. Conditional surface seen: hub rows Identification details and Transit countries appear only once owed; the Transit countries summary card appears only when transit countries exist. Seeded traces (change-from-cya and all 11 view-state traces) seed by posting the real journey forms from an API request context, which also reveals each form's redirect target outside change context and the declaration -> confirmation redirect. Not reached in this slice (recorded as gaps): the Delete page, the confirmation page, amendment state (Cancel amendment), Edit details links, Change links other than import details and additional animal details, task-page validation errors, hub statuses other than To do and Complete, the exit-details conditional row, and any backend call (the browser only talks to the frontend).

claims.statement: Pressing 'Start a new notification' POSTs to /live-animals/notifications, which creates the notification, mints its GBN-AG reference and redirects straight to that notification's origin page.
